explication: Cosmos is a model platform for physical-AI generation and reasoning; the supplied source excerpts chiefly expose its VLMEvalKit evaluation workflow. An evaluator selects datasets and models, runs inference, saves predictions, then scores them. The README also documents generator and reasoner use, while the tree includes generator evaluation suites. Core model-generation implementation is not shown, so those capabilities are represented only at the documented level; links without direct evidence are omitted.
